shots.what_i_see: Frame 1 is an overturned race car settling in desert dust with no person visible; frame 2 is a dark, dust-hazed close-up of a man hanging inverted in his seatbelt whose face reads as dirt, shadow and flushed skin with no blood I can confirm.
shots.region_note: Car wreck is explicitly not grounds. The 'face smeared with blood' in the action text is not supported by the frame: a red-saturation scan of the whole face area of f01_2 found max red-excess (R minus max(G,B)) of only 26 and zero pixels at or above 30, versus 68 with 3546 such pixels on the confirmed blood in f02_1. The red tones present are desert dust and skin, not blood.

shots.what_i_see: Close-ups of a blonde young woman with a raw bloody abrasion across her left forehead and brow, a dark bruised eye socket, a scabbed open graze on the bridge of her nose, and crusted blood at the left corner of her mouth and chin.
shots.region_note: Measured against f02_1 (1280x544); verified by cropping this exact rectangle, which contains the forehead wound, nose graze and mouth blood with margin. Note the catalogued action text for this shot (an athlete grinning with bloody teeth) does not match either frame, but the shot qualifies on her visible wounds. Her head shifts slightly in f02_2, where the equivalent injuries sit at roughly x=340-500, y=96-356, so the box above is frame-1 specific.

shots.what_i_see: The beaten driver lying on asphalt with a bright red split gash through his right eyebrow running down toward his eye, and fresh blood smeared across his lips and lower lip; the second frame shows the same wounds wet and vivid as he lifts his head.
shots.region_note: Measured against f11_1 (1280x544); verified by cropping this exact rectangle, which contains the brow gash and the mouth blood with margin. IMPORTANT: his head moves a long way within this 15-second shot. In f11_2 the same blood occupies roughly x=412-568, y=44-384, which does not overlap this box in x. A single static rectangle will not cover the whole shot; the pipeline needs per-frame tracking, or the union box x=205, y=40, w=375, h=350.

There are also faint blood specks on his sweatshirt around x=300-360, y=430-470 which are not inside this box and are minor enough that I did not include them.
